newsitem.title: USA: Tele-Comms board holding special meeting.
newsitem.headline: Tele-Comms board holding special meeting.

text.p: The board of Tele-Communications Inc is holding a special board meeting later Friday morning, a spokesman said.

He declined to disclose the agenda and would not comment on speculation Chief Executive Officer, Chairman and President John Malone is prepared to relinquish the title of president and bring another cable executive on board.
The Wall Street Journal reported that Malone may bring in cable executive Leo Hindery, head of San Francisco based InterMedia Partners, as president.
The TCI spokesman would only say that an announcement was expected sometime on Friday after the board meeting.
TCI, the nation's largest cable television operator, in December announced a cost cutting plan that included selling off its corporate planes and layoffs amounting to 6.5 percent of the workforce.
The cable giant saw its stock price weaken and investors were concerned.
On Friday TCI shares were up 1/8 at 13-7/8, up from the year low of 11-5/16.
TCI got itself into a public relations nightmare last month when it pulled Viacom Inc's VH1 music video channel.

It received hundreds of phone calls from irate VH1 fans and changed its plans the day before four rock stars were set to hold a press conference in Denver -- close enough to TCI's headquarters in Englewood, Colo., to prove an embarassment.
